what: On hover the text blurs out in place (up to 28% of .45s), moves 15px down and hides briefly (up to 40%), then rises and reappears (ease-out, once). A ”rewritten” gesture for rounded hashtag chips and small buttons

options.--fx-drop: Distance it sinks down before rising again (set via style), default 15px
options.[data-fx-part=rerise]: Text that floats back up (child, required — switched to inline-block)

from.where: index.css .ez-film__list li:hover span (original hoverFadeUp — hashtag circle strip)
